title: Unified Marketing & Sales Analytics Dashboard
summary: One dashboard that brings webinars, email campaigns, social posts and sales calls together so leadership can see performance in one place.
headline: Every marketing and sales number on one screen
problem: Performance data was spread across webinar, email, social and call tools, so getting a clear picture meant manual tracking.
solution: I built a Vite and React dashboard on Supabase that aggregates data from each channel. n8n and Zapier workflows keep the data fresh, and the dashboard turns it into clear KPIs and charts for each department.
highlights: Overview of webinars, registrations, emails sent and revenue
Email performance over time with open and click rates
Social post impressions and reactions for Facebook and LinkedIn
role: Sole engineer. I built the dashboard and database, and the integrations and automations that feed it.

results.label: One view of marketing, email, social and sales performance
Manual reporting replaced by automatic data collection
A base to add more reports as the business grows
